definitions.success_denominator: Every planned method job, including pending, blocked, timeout and errors
definitions.attempt_selection: Only the latest attempt of each planned job contributes its status, costs and timings to method statistics; older attempts are never substituted or pooled
definitions.history_statuses: All attempts in numeric order, with their recorded receipt status and seal state; the selected row status additionally applies current dependency validity
definitions.paired_cost: Same case, objective, cost units and nonempty frozen input_hash; both strictly validated; finite costs
definitions.missing: Null means unavailable; missing timings and costs are never replaced by zero
definitions.ratios: Mean of per-case ratios; zero baseline cost excluded from ratio only
definitions.timing: wall_seconds uses external attempt process wall time when available; worker wall and solver time retain separate scopes
definitions.uncertainty: Sample standard deviations only; no iid confidence intervals inferred from dependent roadmap repetitions
